evals.prompt: Review the Codacy analysis for an existing PR and verify the local scan actually ran before reporting its findings.
evals.expected_output: Run the strict local PR analysis, inspect toolResults and unavailable capabilities, then supplement it with Codacy Cloud PR data when available.

evals.prompt: A PR scan reports one Critical security issue and several minor style issues. Which findings block review?
evals.expected_output: Flag Critical and High severity findings as blockers; report the exact location and evidence, and keep lower-severity items distinct.
assertions: contains:.agents/skills/codacy-code-review/SKILL.md|Flag Critical and High severity issues as blockers

evals.prompt: The repository is not available in Codacy Cloud. Can I still confirm its Cloud coverage delta and quality gate?
evals.expected_output: No. Coverage, quality-gate status, and duplication metrics are Cloud-only; report them as unavailable while keeping local analysis separate.

evals.prompt: Change a UI button label. No pull-request review or Codacy analysis is requested.
evals.expected_output: Make the UI change without creating a Codacy review report.
